messages.subject: Shiny app TableTools issue
parts:
I have made one shiny app layout and used TableTools to get the print table button. When I run the app locally it gives no problem but the deployed app over shiny.io doesn't show this button. The button is supposed to be at top of dataframe at last panel. The code is located athttps://www.dropbox.com/s/1y0bte1p23nblit/shiny2.rar?dl=0 and deployed athttp://yogeshbansal.shinyapps.io/shiny2

I shared the dropbox link because there were a lot of javascripts in folder within shiny app and sharing server.R and ui.R wouldn't have suffice. My personal opinion is there is some kind of issue regarding folder structure for including javascript files but then how the app is able to run in local run successfully. I use CRAN version of R.
